title_en: Nexspace releases ‘Maple Story Universe’ first half report… Cumulative revenue: 58.22 million NXPC
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Nexspace announced the financial results for the first half of 2026, which includes the on-chain economic status and token distribution structure of the blockchain ecosystem 'MapleStory Universe'. Nexspace announced on the 9th that it has released the '2026 First Half Report' covering the on-chain economy of the MapleStory Universe ecosystem. According to the report, MapleStory Universe generated protocol revenue of approximately 30.98 million NXPC during the first half of this year. This figure exceeds the approximately 28.14 million NXPC distributed as user play rewards in the blockchain-based MMORPG ‘Maple Story N’, and as of June 30, the cumulative protocol revenue totaled 58.22 million NXPC. In terms of profit structure, ‘core gameplay content’, which includes voluntary consumption such as item strengthening and synthesis, accounted for approximately 95% of the total. Nexspace implemented a quarterly burn policy introduced in November last year. Based on this, incineration was carried out twice in connection with profits in the first half of the year. Approximately 2,876,500 NXPCs were burned on May 21st and approximately 3,325,500 NXPCs on July 16th. Accordingly, the cumulative amount of NXPCs burned since launch has been approximately 11.65 million. All incineration details were transparently disclosed on-chain. title_en: Lightning Market acquires management system international standard certification ‘ISO·IEC 27001’
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Lightning Market announced on the 9th that it has acquired 'ISO/IEC 27001', an international standard certification for information security management system established by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) and the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC). ISO 27001 includes 93 detailed control items across four areas, including ▲information protection policy, ▲access control, ▲physical security, and ▲accident response. summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Korea Zinc Chairman Choi Yoon-beom won the extraordinary shareholders' meeting vote battle with Youngpoong and MBK Partners, which are in a management rights dispute, and secured an advantageous position on the board of directors. Korea Zinc held an extraordinary shareholders' meeting at the Mondrian Hotel in Yongsan-gu, Seoul on the 9th and appointed four general independent directors and one independent director who will become an audit committee member. Among the 19 directors in the articles of incorporation, four outside directors are suspended from their duties. He resigned at the end of May, and the vacancy that occurred as the number of audit committee members had to be expanded from 1 to 2 or more in accordance with the revised Commercial Act was filled. At this extraordinary shareholders' meeting, independent directors Hyeong-gyu Lee, Eun-sook Seo, Jun-bong Lee, and Hye-seop Shim, who were nominated, were appointed. Candidates Hyeong-gyu Lee and Eun-sook Seo were recommended by Korea Zinc, and directors Joon-bong Lee and Hye-seop Shim were recommended by Youngpoong and MBK. Candidate Baek In-gyu, recommended by Korea Zinc, was selected as the member of the audit committee that attracted the most attention. Korea Zinc's board of directors announced that more than half of the voting rights present at the extraordinary shareholders' meeting on this day were in favor of the appointment of Candidate Park. It was rejected as it did not meet the majority approval requirement. In terms of preferred shareholding, Youngpoong and MBK had 42.1%, slightly ahead of Chairman Choi's 38.75%, but the ‘3% rule’ determined the winner…

summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア] OTTモアはガールズグループの球球団出身のサリーが出演する中国ロマンスドラマ「ビドア審賞、あなたに向けた飛行」を披露すると9日明らかにした。原作は人気ロマンスウェブ小説「ガンラクアシム賞」で、中国最大のウェブ小説プラットフォーム鎮江文学省で9点対評価を記録した。チョンチョルミョンは副社長プーミンウィ役を引き受け、普段は冷徹だが、愛する人の前ではスムーズに変化する魅力を披露する。廃止と副社長のプーミンウィの誤解で退社した뤼츠셴は、3年後に有望なパイロットに成長し、ハンツ航空に復帰する。プーミンウィは、根津シェンを直接迎え入れるが、過去の誤解と事故が重なり、二人は再び危機に直面する。
title_en: OTT MOA, Chinese romance drama ‘Bidoasimsang’ released on the 9th
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] OTT MOA announced on the 9th that it will present the Chinese romance drama 'Bidoa Simsang, Flight Toward You' starring Sally from the girl group Gugudan. The drama released on this day tells the story of Sally, who plays flight attendant Ron Sixian, who challenges herself to become a pilot after leaving the company. The original work is the popular romance web novel ‘Gangrak Asimsang’, which recorded a rating of 9 on China’s largest web novel platform, Jinjiang Literary City. The co-star will be played by Wei Cheol-myeong, who appeared in ‘National Color Burning Flower’ and ‘Wan Mi Teacher’s Flower Chabu Da So Jeo’. Wei Cheol-myeong plays the role of Vice President Fu Ming-yu, who is usually cold-hearted, but shows a charm that changes gently in front of the person he loves. The drama depicts the growth and romance of the main character in a three-stage narrative of ‘a rupture in the relationship due to a misunderstanding, three years of desperate pride, and a reunion in a reversed relationship.’ Ron Sixian, who left the company due to the abolition of the in-house pilot training program and a misunderstanding with Vice President Fu Ming-yu, grows into a promising pilot three years later and returns to Hengshi Airlines. Fu Ming-yu directly recruits Ron Shi-hsian, but the two face a crisis again as past misunderstandings and accidents overlap. Moa said, "The key point of the work is the process in which the outspoken new pilot and the cool-headed vice president develop from an enemy relationship into each other's strong support," adding, "I am also looking forward to the chemistry between Sally and Wei Cheol-myeong...

The original description that it was ``produced by an illustrator'' was revised to more accurately say ``a graphic designer.''

summary_ko: 가고시마현 이부스키시에서 개최하는 풀 마라톤 대회의 포스터에 대해, X상에서 「생성 AI로 제작한 것이 아닐까」라는 지적이 잇따르고 있다. 대회 사무국은 9월 8일, 제작 과정에서 생성 AI를 이용하고 있었다고 밝히고, 공식 사이트의 설명도 정정. 당초 「일러스트레이터에게 제작해 주셨다」고 했던 기술을, 정확하게는 「그래픽 디자이너」였다고 개정했다.
